reviews.title: The Best!
reviews.text: I have tried all, if not, almost all the scanning apps avail in the app store. Genius Scan is by far the easiest to use and produces the clearest scans. The edit functions work well, most especially the crop tool. If you scan something in angle or crookedly, it allows you to crop the image by perspective to straighten it out. i highly recommend this product!

reviews.title: Look No Further!
reviews.text: I am so glad my employer recommended Genius Scan. I had downloaded so many scanner apps, but none did all that I wanted in a scanning app until my workplace recommended Genius Scan. It automatically crops documents. It’s easy to add and delete pages, rename the document, and send it in a variety of ways. That’s just the beginning. I’ve recommended it to family, friends, and colleagues, and never heard a complaint. Enjoy!
